objective: Build and qualify a Qwen3-32B-aligned PARD-2 target-dependent checkpoint without changing the QuaRot or PARD-2 inference architecture.

forbidden: load the full BF16 Qwen3-32B teacher on the R9700
load the teacher and trainable drafter concurrently on the R9700
start a larger data tier before its parent gate passes
change target quantization, kernel dimensions, K1, taps and trainable scope in one experiment

data_contract.existing_collector_policy: e2e/pard2_collect_features.py must not be used for TD32 training or model selection because its tune prompts overlap the formal benchmark and its metadata is fixed to the 8B profile.

diagnostic_metrics: raw and projected feature cosine similarity
measurement_contract.decision_metric: paired end-to-end performance; steady throughput alone cannot pass a gate

experiments.hypothesis: A leakage-free data and provenance contract can be established before any GPU work.
work: create train, calibration_tune and heldout_validation manifests
prove zero prompt/token overlap with formal 80/80/20
capture dirty source file hashes and immutable model/kernel revisions
estimate token, host RAM and disk use before materializing a shard
go_gate: all required provenance fields are present
formal overlap count is zero
projected disk free after the next shard remains at least 25 GiB

experiments.hypothesis: The quantized 32B teacher can emit deterministic selected hidden states within the R9700 resource gates.
go_gate: all selected features are finite and deterministic
each candidate concatenates to width 20480
VRAM and thermal gates pass
measured bytes/token and tokens/s produce a feasible S2 estimate

experiments.hypothesis: A streamed diagonal affine map can align 32B legacy taps to the 14B feature space enough to produce non-zero acceptance.
experiments.trainable_scope: online sufficient statistics for per-channel affine only
go_gate: three heldout task strata each accept at least one draft token
aggregate mean accept length >=2.0
exact AR parity

experiments.hypothesis: Depth-scaled 14B taps transfer better to the 64-layer target than fixed negative indices.
experiments.trainable_scope: online sufficient statistics for per-channel affine only
go_gate: three heldout task strata each accept at least one draft token
aggregate mean accept length >=2.0
exact AR parity

experiments.hypothesis: Evenly spaced 64-layer taps provide a stronger low/mid/high feature basis.
experiments.trainable_scope: online sufficient statistics for per-channel affine only
go_gate: three heldout task strata each accept at least one draft token
aggregate mean accept length >=2.0
exact AR parity

experiments.parent_selector: best passing TD32-S2 candidate selected on heldout validation only
experiments.hypothesis: Training only the 20,972,544-parameter 20480-to-1024 projection can recover useful 32B target alignment.
experiments.loss: official CAT-weighted CE+KD; exact vocabulary-chunked KD is allowed, top-k substitution is not silent
go_gate: validation loss is finite and improves from initialization
every heldout task stratum has mean accept length >=2.0
exact AR parity
paired E2E does not regress versus the selected affine parent
stop_gate: parent acceptance is not improved after the fixed token budget

experiments.hypothesis: More diverse data improves alignment without changing the drafter backbone.
go_gate: each heldout task reaches at least 90% of its paired TI mean acceptance
paired E2E is not below the selected S2/S3 parent
no heldout task regresses more than 2%
stop_gate: four-times-more data gives less than 5% relative acceptance improvement
feature cache cannot preserve the disk reserve

experiments.hypothesis: Projection-only calibration can meet or exceed the existing TI acceptance baseline.
go_gate: heldout mean acceptance is no lower than paired TI on every task
paired TD/TI E2E >=1.03
resource and parity gates pass
stop_gate: acceptance improves but paired E2E does not; profile overhead before any unfreeze

experiments.hypothesis: If projection capacity saturates, limited drafter adaptation can close the remaining alignment gap.
experiments.only_changed_variable: unfreeze the top four drafter layers
experiments.trainable_scope: target_proj plus top four drafter layers
go_gate: paired TD/TI E2E improves by at least 3% over S5
no task acceptance regresses more than 2%
training VRAM remains below 95%
stop_gate: optimizer plus activations exceed the R9700 gate

experiments.hypothesis: Full 0.8B drafter adaptation is necessary only after projection and partial-unfreeze capacity are disproved.
experiments.decision: do not launch automatically on the R9700

experiments.parent_selector: first checkpoint that passes S5 or S6 heldout gates
experiments.hypothesis: The selected aligned checkpoint remains lossless and safe at deployment cache sizes.
experiments.evaluation: one fixed heldout prompt per task, then 16/16/8 heldout prompts
go_gate: exact AR parity for every run
external and torch VRAM gates pass
no OOM, ROCm fault, NaN or illegal shape
paired TD/TI E2E >=1.03

experiments.hypothesis: A frozen TD32 checkpoint provides statistically supported deployment benefit over AR and TI.
experiments.evaluation: HumanEval 80, GSM8K 80, MATH-500 20, three sweeps, 8192 cache
go_gate: 540/540 exact AR output-token parity
TD/AR paired speedup bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >1 on every task
paired TD/TI E2E >=1.03
speedup CV <5%
95% VRAM and thermal gates pass
experiments.decision: only this stage may promote a checkpoint to canonical TD
